facts.summary: Phase 2 monotherapy trial failed to beat placebo on clinical remission · Phase 2 · AMT-101 in ulcerative colitis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The clinical remission (CR) rate in patients treated with AMT-101 monotherapy was 17.1% (12/70 patients) compared to a CR rate of 20.0% (7/35 patients) with placebo
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: 17.1% (12/70) of patients treated in the monotherapy arm (AMT-101 3mg) achieved clinical remission versus 20.0% (7/35) in patients receiving placebo at week 12.
evidence.safety: AMT-101 was well-tolerated. Treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs) were mostly mild to moderate and were generally balanced between the two arms.
